credits.title: The Champs
credits.overview: A stubborn and hotheaded minor league basketball coach is forced to train a Special Olympics team when he is sentenced to community service.

credits.title: Glowurm
credits.overview: A group of young eco-hackers infiltrates an abandoned experimental center in the Alps to document a space-time anomaly - a hidden dimension that transforms into a trap.

credits.title: Paternal Leave
credits.overview: Torn between longing and anger, 15-year-old Leo travels to the coast of northern Italy to meet her biological father. The two are complete strangers to each other. They struggle to find truth, affinity, love and the courage to face themselves.
